title: Is Multilingual LLM Watermarking Truly Multilingual? A Simple Back-Translation Solution
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of Large Language Model watermarking across diverse languages and introduces a new detection method called STEAM. While it contains a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section and discusses fairness in the context of linguistic representation (high vs. low resource languages), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
